sourceReview.reason: Full original finance.biggo.com report for the claimed November 18 non-monetary-trust legislative gap could not be accessed or corroborated by two independent full-text reports. The FSC October 1 rulemaking confirms a February 4, 2027 implementation target but not this new reported industry reaction or claimed gap.
